newsitem.title: USA: Novoste gets notice of Beta-Cath patent.
newsitem.headline: Novoste gets notice of Beta-Cath patent.

text.p: Novoste Corp said it has received a notice of allowance from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office for its Beta-Cath System.
Typically, a U.S. patent issues within a few months of its notice of allowance, the company said.

Novoste said its patent will protect its intracoronary radiation catheter system, as well as its method of use. Additional patent applications are pending in the United States and in foreign countries, the company said.
